ThoughtDef::AlcoholWithdrawal.label: off the still-brew
ThoughtDef::AlcoholWithdrawal.description: My hands won't stop shaking and everything grates on me. All I can think about is the taste of the last bottle I drained.

ThoughtDef::AmbrosiaWithdrawal.label: ambrosia craving
ThoughtDef::AmbrosiaWithdrawal.description: I'm cold clear through, heavy in the bones. Never thought I'd crave a piece of fruit this bad, but I'd trade good chrome for one bite of ambrosia right now.

ThoughtDef::Ascetic.label: content with little
ThoughtDef::Ascetic.description: My bunk is bare and small, just how I like it. No use hanging chrome on the wall when it could keep the vaporators running instead.

ThoughtDef::AteCorpse.label: ate a raw carcass
ThoughtDef::AteCorpse.description: I tore meat straight off a dead animal's bones, no butchering, no fire. Out here you eat what's in front of you or you don't eat, but I still feel sick about it.

ThoughtDef::AteFineMeal.label: ate a fine meal
ThoughtDef::AteFineMeal.description: Real spice, real meat, cooked right. Out here that's worth more than scrap, and I savored every bite.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanlikeMeatAsIngredient.label: ate cooked sapient flesh
ThoughtDef::AteHumanlikeMeatAsIngredient.description: I ate a meal cooked from the flesh of one of the free peoples. It's mixed in there quiet as scrap-meat, but I know what it is, and it turns my stomach.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanlikeMeatAsIngredient.label: ate cooked sapient flesh
ThoughtDef::AteHumanlikeMeatAsIngredient.description: I ate a meal built from someone's flesh, dressed up nice with what herbs we had. Better than most rations I've had on this rock, don't tell the others I said that.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanlikeMeatDirect.label: ate raw sapient flesh
ThoughtDef::AteHumanlikeMeatDirect.description: I ate the raw flesh of one of the free peoples, no fire, no cooking, like a womp-rat scavenging a carcass. I can still taste it and I want to scrub my own mouth out with sand.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanlikeMeatDirectCannib.label: ate raw sapient flesh
ThoughtDef::AteHumanlikeMeatDirectCannib.description: Raw, still warm, no seasoning needed. I ate it like an animal would, and it was better than any ration cube I've cracked open out here.

ThoughtDef::AteInImpressiveDiningRoom.label: ate in a fine mess hall
ThoughtDef::AteInImpressiveDiningRoom.description: We ate somewhere that actually looks cared for, swept floor, steady light, chairs that match. Feels good to sit down to a meal like that.

ThoughtDef::AteInsectMeatAsIngredient.label: ate cooked insect meat
ThoughtDef::AteInsectMeatAsIngredient.description: The seasoning mostly covered the taste of the gray, slimy meat underneath, but I still bit into something soft and wet I couldn't name. Better not to ask what crawled into this pot.

ThoughtDef::AteInsectMeatDirect.label: ate insect meat
ThoughtDef::AteInsectMeatDirect.description: Gray, slimy, and it popped wrong between my teeth. Might be the worst thing I've put in my mouth since the water ration went bad.

ThoughtDef::AteKibble.label: ate kibble
ThoughtDef::AteKibble.description: I ate the same pressed meal-scraps we feed the banthas. Makes me feel like just another animal working this camp for its keep.

ThoughtDef::AteLavishMeal.label: ate a lavish meal
ThoughtDef::AteLavishMeal.description: That was a real feast, good meat, good spice, no scrimping. Fed something in me that isn't just my stomach.

ThoughtDef::AteNutrientPasteMeal.label: ate nutrient paste
ThoughtDef::AteNutrientPasteMeal.description: Gray paste out of the dispenser again, no taste, no texture worth mentioning. Keeps me standing, that's all it's good for.

ThoughtDef::AteRawFood.label: ate raw food
ThoughtDef::AteRawFood.description: I ate it raw, straight off the cutting board, no fire under it. We've got a stove for a reason, this isn't how people are supposed to eat.

ThoughtDef::AteRawHumanlikeMeat.label: ate raw sapient meat
ThoughtDef::AteRawHumanlikeMeat.description: I ate the raw flesh of one of the free peoples. No fire touched it. I don't know how to feel about what that makes me.

ThoughtDef::AteRottenFood.label: ate rotten food
ThoughtDef::AteRottenFood.description: Whatever that was, it had gone soft and wrong days before I ate it. It practically dissolved in my mouth, and not the way food is supposed to.

ThoughtDef::AteWithoutTable.label: ate without a table
ThoughtDef::AteWithoutTable.description: Ate crouched in the sand again, plate balanced on my knee. We haul scrap for half the sector, you'd think we could scavenge one decent table.

ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalBanished.label: bonded animal {0} banished
ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalBanished.description: They cast my animal out of the camp. That creature and I were bonded, how could they just send it into the waste like that?

ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalDied.label: bonded animal {0} died
ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalDied.description: It was one of a kind to me, and now it's gone. This galaxy doesn't care what it takes from you.

ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalLost.label: bonded animal {0} lost
ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalLost.description: It was one of a kind to me, and now it's gone from my life. Out here you lose things, I know that, but this one still stings.

ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalMaster.label: with my bonded animal {0}
ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalMaster.description: Having my animal near settles something in me. Out on this rock, that bond is worth more than most people I've met.

ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalReleased.label: bonded animal {0} released
ThoughtDef::BondedAnimalReleased.description: They let my animal go, set it loose into the dunes. It was one of a kind to me, why did it have to be that one?

ThoughtDef::BrawlerUnhappy.label: wants to brawl, not shoot
ThoughtDef::BrawlerUnhappy.description: I hate picking things off from a distance with a blaster I barely trust. Give me a blade and let me get in close where I can actually feel the fight.

ThoughtDef::BrokeUpWithMe.label: broke up with me
ThoughtDef::BrokeUpWithMe.description: They ended it between us, just like that. I keep replaying it, trying to work out where it went wrong.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHumanlikeCorpse.label: butchered a sapient corpse
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHumanlikeCorpse.description: I cut up a body like it was game meat off the sand, joints, cuts, the whole grim business. I know why we needed it, but it doesn't sit right.

ThoughtDef::ButcheredHumanlikeCorpseOpin.label: butchered a sapient corpse
ThoughtDef::ButcheredHumanlikeCorpseOpin.description: I heard what they did to that body, cut it up like scrap metal on a bench. I can't look at them quite the same way now.

ThoughtDef::CheatedOnMe.label: cheated on me
ThoughtDef::CheatedOnMe.description: They went behind my back with someone else. I trusted them, and that trust is scrap now.

ThoughtDef::CheatedOnMeMood.label: cheated on by {0}
ThoughtDef::CheatedOnMeMood.description: How could they do that to me? I gave them more than I give most people out here, and this is what I get back.

ThoughtDef::ClothedNudist.label: constrained by clothes
ThoughtDef::ClothedNudist.description: I'm no fan of wrappings and layers, but I'm bundled up anyway. Not unbearable, just chafing, like sand caught under a strap.

ThoughtDef::ColonistBanishedToDie.label: banished someone to die
ThoughtDef::ColonistBanishedToDie.description: We put them out past the dunes with nothing, knowing full well the desert doesn't forgive that. That's as good as a death sentence and we all know it.

ThoughtDef::ColonistLeftUnburied.label: left unburied
ThoughtDef::ColonistLeftUnburied.description: One of ours is dead and just lying out there in the open, food for scavengers. Nobody deserves that, everybody gets buried properly, or at least burned right.

ThoughtDef::ColonyPrisonerEscaped.label: a prisoner escaped
ThoughtDef::ColonyPrisonerEscaped.description: A prisoner slipped right out of our hands. If we can't hold onto someone we've got chained up, what's actually keeping the rest of us safe here?

ThoughtDef::DeadMansApparel.label: wearing a dead man's gear
ThoughtDef::DeadMansApparel.description: This gear came off someone who died in it. I scrubbed it down and it's still good kit, but it feels wrong against my skin.

ThoughtDef::DoingPassionateWork.label: loves this work
ThoughtDef::DoingPassionateWork.description: This is the work I was built for, or as close as I'll ever get. Give me this all day and I'd never once complain about the heat.

ThoughtDef::DrugDesireFascination.label: craving chems
ThoughtDef::DrugDesireFascination.description: Chems fascinate me, I want to feel that again, and worse, I want more of it than I did last time.

ThoughtDef::DrugDesireFascinationSatisfi.label: chems satisfied
ThoughtDef::DrugDesireFascinationSatisfi.description: Chems fascinate me, and getting my fix again felt as good as I hoped it would.

ThoughtDef::DrugDesireInterest.label: curious about chems
ThoughtDef::DrugDesireInterest.description: I'm curious about chems, not obsessed, just curious enough that I keep thinking about trying a little more.

ThoughtDef::DrugDesireInterestSatisfied.label: chems satisfied
ThoughtDef::DrugDesireInterestSatisfied.description: I'm curious about chems, and scratching that itch again felt good.

ThoughtDef::Drunk.label: drunk
ThoughtDef::Drunk.description: The drink's got hold of me now. Everything's a little looser, a little slower, a little further away.

ThoughtDef::EnvironmentCold.label: cold
ThoughtDef::EnvironmentCold.description: The desert nights cut right through whatever I'm wearing. I can't stop shivering, and all I can think about is getting near a heater.

ThoughtDef::EnvironmentDark.label: in the dark
ThoughtDef::EnvironmentDark.description: I've been stuck without decent light for too long now. Out here in the dark, every sound could be something with teeth.

ThoughtDef::EnvironmentHot.label: too hot
ThoughtDef::EnvironmentHot.description: Twin suns overhead and no shade in sight, I'm cooking in my own skin. I'd give good credits for one breath of cool air.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner.label: executed a prisoner
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner.description: We put a prisoner down instead of letting them go or keeping them chained. That's not a decision that sits easy, whatever the reason was.

ThoughtDef::ForcedMeToTakeDrugs.label: forced me to take chems
ThoughtDef::ForcedMeToTakeDrugs.description: They forced something into me I never would've taken on my own. I still feel it in my blood and I don't like what that says about them.

ThoughtDef::ForcedMeToTakeDrugsMood.label: forced to take chems
ThoughtDef::ForcedMeToTakeDrugsMood.description: I don't touch chems, not ever, not by choice. Somebody forced it into me anyway, and now I feel like something's crawling under my skin.

ThoughtDef::ForcedMeToTakeLuciferiumMood.label: forced to take luciferium
ThoughtDef::ForcedMeToTakeLuciferiumMood.description: I keep my body my own, no implants, no chems, nothing not born in me. They forced luciferium into me anyway, and now I feel hollowed out and refilled with something else.

ThoughtDef::GoJuiceHigh.label: high on go-juice
ThoughtDef::GoJuiceHigh.description: I'm wired but steady, every nerve dialed in tight. Point me at a target and I won't miss.

ThoughtDef::GoJuiceWithdrawal.label: go-juice withdrawal
ThoughtDef::GoJuiceWithdrawal.description: My head's full of sand, my limbs weigh twice what they should, and my eyes won't hold still on anything. Everything hurts and I can't tell you why.

ThoughtDef::GotMarried.label: got married to {0}
ThoughtDef::GotMarried.description: We're bonded now, properly, in front of everyone. Starting something new together feels like the best trade I've ever made.

ThoughtDef::Greedy.label: wants a better bunk
ThoughtDef::Greedy.description: I want a room that actually looks like something, not this bare hole I sleep in. A little more than I have would go a long way.

ThoughtDef::HadAngeringFight.label: had an angering fight
ThoughtDef::HadAngeringFight.description: That fight left me shaking with anger, not relief. I'm still turning it over, still furious.

ThoughtDef::HadCatharticFight.label: had a cathartic fight
ThoughtDef::HadCatharticFight.description: Got some things off my chest with my fists instead of my mouth. Feels like I let go of something I'd been carrying too long.

ThoughtDef::HappyNude.label: happily nude
ThoughtDef::HappyNude.description: No wraps, no layers, nothing between me and the air. I feel free out here, more myself than I do bundled up in gear.

ThoughtDef::HardWorkerVsLazy.label: hard worker vs. lazy
ThoughtDef::HardWorkerVsLazy.description: I put in the hours every single day, and I watch them drag their feet. Hard not to resent someone who lets the rest of us carry the load.

ThoughtDef::HoldingMePrisoner.label: holding me prisoner
ThoughtDef::HoldingMePrisoner.description: They're keeping me chained up here against my will. I don't forget who put me in this cell, whatever else they do for me.

ThoughtDef::HospitalPatientRoomStats.label: in a rough infirmary
ThoughtDef::HospitalPatientRoomStats.description: This sickbay is barely holding together, cracked walls, bad light, whatever was on hand when they built it. Hard to heal right in a place like this.

ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparelHappy.label: wearing sapient-hide gear
ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparelHappy.description: I like wearing what I took off someone who couldn't stop me. Anyone who looks close enough will know exactly what kind of person they're dealing with.

ThoughtDef::Hungover.label: hungover
ThoughtDef::Hungover.description: My skull is pounding like someone's hammering dents out of it. Whatever I drank last night, it wasn't worth this.

ThoughtDef::Inebriated.label: feeling the drink
ThoughtDef::Inebriated.description: That drink's loosened something in me, warm, a little unsteady, not minding much of anything right now.

ThoughtDef::Insulted.label: insulted
ThoughtDef::Insulted.description: They insulted me straight to my face. I'm not going to forget that anytime soon.

ThoughtDef::InsultedMood.label: insulted
ThoughtDef::InsultedMood.description: Somebody just insulted me right to my face, no shame about it at all. What kind of person does that to someone they work beside?

ThoughtDef::Jealous.label: jealous of {0}'s bunk
ThoughtDef::Jealous.description: Their room's better than mine and I can't stop noticing it. I need the best space here, not seconds.

ThoughtDef::JoyActivityInImpressiveRecRo.label: had fun in a good rec room
ThoughtDef::JoyActivityInImpressiveRecRo.description: Blew off some steam somewhere that actually looks nice for once, decent light, decent seating, no scrap piled in the corner. Made the fun better.

ThoughtDef::KilledColonyAnimal.label: culled our own stock
ThoughtDef::KilledColonyAnimal.description: I killed one of the colony's own beasts. It wasn't a raider, it was ours. My gut doesn't like that math.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyBondedAnimal.label: killed my bonded beast
ThoughtDef::KilledMyBondedAnimal.description: I killed the animal that walked at my heel every day. My own hands did that. I don't think the guilt washes off like sand does.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyFriend.label: killed my friend
ThoughtDef::KilledMyFriend.description: I killed someone who trusted me at my back. However it happened, that's a debt I can't pay off in scrap.

ThoughtDef::KilledMyLover.label: killed my lover
ThoughtDef::KilledMyLover.description: My own hands ended the one I loved. No amount of sand or silence buries that.

ThoughtDef::KnowButcheredHumanlikeCorpse.label: we butchered a person
ThoughtDef::KnowButcheredHumanlikeCorpse.description: We broke someone down like they were parts off a busted droid, not a person. I know it. It doesn't sit right in my chest.

ThoughtDef::KnowColonistDied.label: one of ours died
ThoughtDef::KnowColonistDied.description: One of our own is off the manifest for good. We're supposed to look after our people better than that.

ThoughtDef::KnowColonistExecuted.label: a colonist was put down
ThoughtDef::KnowColonistExecuted.description: The clan judged and it was carried out — execution or a mercy killing, whichever it was. Right by clan law doesn't make it feel any less like losing someone.

ThoughtDef::KnowGuestExecuted.label: a guest was put down
ThoughtDef::KnowGuestExecuted.description: We judged a prisoner or guest and ended them, execution or mercy — call it justice, call it kindness. Either way it's still a body that used to talk to us.

ThoughtDef::KnowGuestOrganHarvested.label: harvested a guest's organs
ThoughtDef::KnowGuestOrganHarvested.description: We cut pieces out of someone who never got a say. Doesn't matter that we needed the parts — that's a rotten kind of salvage.

ThoughtDef::KnowPrisonerSold.label: sold a prisoner
ThoughtDef::KnowPrisonerSold.description: We traded a living person off like they were spare plating. Even out here, that one turns my stomach.

ThoughtDef::MasochistPain.label: the pain feels good
ThoughtDef::MasochistPain.description: Ow... heh. There's something almost right about the sting. Don't stop now — I could get used to running hot like this.

ThoughtDef::MyAuntDied.label: my aunt {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyAuntDied.description: My aunt's gone. One more name off the family ledger.

ThoughtDef::MyBrotherDied.label: my brother {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyBrotherDied.description: My brother's dead. Same blood as me, and now half of it's gone.

ThoughtDef::MyCousinDied.label: my cousin {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyCousinDied.description: My cousin didn't make it. Same blood, same clan — that one leaves a mark.

ThoughtDef::MyDaughterDied.label: my daughter {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyDaughterDied.description: My daughter is dead. She was my own blood — I don't know how to carry that.

ThoughtDef::MyFatherDied.label: my father {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyFatherDied.description: My father's gone. He taught me half of what I know, and now he's just gone for good.

ThoughtDef::MyFianceDied.label: my fiance {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyFianceDied.description: My fiance is dead. Whatever we were building together, it's scrap now — my future along with him.

ThoughtDef::MyFianceeDied.label: my fiancee {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyFianceeDied.description: My fiancee is dead. Whatever we were building together, it's scrap now — my future along with her.

ThoughtDef::MyGrandchildDied.label: my grandchild {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyGrandchildDied.description: My grandchild died. Same blood, three generations down, and now that thread's cut.

ThoughtDef::MyGrandparentDied.label: my grandparent {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyGrandparentDied.description: My grandparent's gone. One more root pulled out of the family line.

ThoughtDef::MyHalfSiblingDied.label: my half-sibling {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyHalfSiblingDied.description: My half-sibling died. Half the blood, all of the loss.

ThoughtDef::MyHusbandDied.label: {0} is gone
ThoughtDef::MyHusbandDied.description: My husband's gone. The bunk's got twice the space now and none of the warmth.

ThoughtDef::MyKinDied.label: my kin {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyKinDied.description: One of my kin is dead. That's blood I won't get back.

ThoughtDef::MyLoverDied.label: my lover {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyLoverDied.description: My lover is dead. I'm alone, and the quiet after is worse than the desert ever was.

ThoughtDef::MyLoverLost.label: my lover {0} lost
ThoughtDef::MyLoverLost.description: My lover's gone missing out there. I keep telling myself they'll turn up on the next caravan in.

ThoughtDef::MyMotherDied.label: my mother {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyMotherDied.description: My mother's gone. She's not coming back this time.

ThoughtDef::MyNephewDied.label: my nephew {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyNephewDied.description: My nephew's dead. Such a good kid — gone too soon.

ThoughtDef::MyNieceDied.label: my niece {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyNieceDied.description: My niece's dead. Such a good kid — gone too soon.

ThoughtDef::MySisterDied.label: my sister {0} died
ThoughtDef::MySisterDied.description: My sister's dead. Same blood as me, and now half of it's gone.

ThoughtDef::MySonDied.label: my son {0} died
ThoughtDef::MySonDied.description: My son is dead. My own blood — I don't know how to carry that.

ThoughtDef::MyUncleDied.label: my uncle {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyUncleDied.description: My uncle's gone. One more name off the family ledger.

ThoughtDef::MyWifeDied.label: {0} is gone
ThoughtDef::MyWifeDied.description: My wife's gone. The bunk's got twice the space now and none of the warmth.

ThoughtDef::Naked.label: naked
ThoughtDef::Naked.description: I've got no wraps on at all. Out here that's not modesty, that's bare flesh open to sun and grit — I feel raw.

ThoughtDef::NeedBeauty.label: ugly surroundings
ThoughtDef::NeedBeauty.description: This place is ruin and rot, not honest scrap. I can't stand looking at it any longer.

ThoughtDef::NeedFood.label: gut's empty
ThoughtDef::NeedFood.description: My stomach's gnawing and it's getting hard to think past it. Haven't had a real meal in too long — starting to feel it in my hands.

ThoughtDef::NeedJoy.label: need to unwind
ThoughtDef::NeedJoy.description: It's been too long since I did anything that wasn't work. My hands want a task that isn't labor for once.

ThoughtDef::NeedOutdoors.label: buried too deep
ThoughtDef::NeedOutdoors.description: Too many shifts under solid rock with the whole ridge pressing down on my skull. I need open air and a horizon, not another ceiling.

ThoughtDef::NeedRest.label: running on empty
ThoughtDef::NeedRest.description: I haven't slept enough. My eyes are heavy and my hands are getting careless — I need to lie down before I drop.

ThoughtDef::NeedRoomSize.label: cramped quarters
ThoughtDef::NeedRoomSize.description: This room's barely big enough to turn around in. I feel like cargo stuffed in a crate, not a person with space to breathe.

ThoughtDef::NewColonyHope.label: fresh start
ThoughtDef::NewColonyHope.description: Still finding my feet in this new outpost, but there's something to it. I want to believe this claim pans out.

ThoughtDef::NightOwlDuringTheDay.label: wrong shift
ThoughtDef::NightOwlDuringTheDay.description: My body wants the dark hours, not this glare. Working under the suns just isn't my rhythm.

ThoughtDef::NotBondedAnimalMaster.label: not {0}'s partner
ThoughtDef::NotBondedAnimalMaster.description: I should be working beside my bonded animal, not stuck away from it. We're better as a pair out here.

ThoughtDef::Nuzzled.label: nuzzled by a critter
ThoughtDef::Nuzzled.description: Some little beast pushed its snout into my hand like it actually likes me. Cuts right through the grind — I feel steadier for it.

ThoughtDef::ObservedLayingCorpse.label: saw a body
ThoughtDef::ObservedLayingCorpse.description: There's a corpse just lying out where anyone can see it. Doesn't matter how many I've hauled — that's still unsettling.

ThoughtDef::ObservedLayingRottingCorpse.label: saw a rotting body
ThoughtDef::ObservedLayingRottingCorpse.description: That corpse has been sitting long enough to turn. The smell and the sight together turn my stomach.

ThoughtDef::Pain.label: in pain
ThoughtDef::Pain.description: Ow — that actually hurts. Hard to keep my head on anything else while it's got hold of me.

ThoughtDef::PawnWithBadOpinionDied.label: my rival {0} died
ThoughtDef::PawnWithBadOpinionDied.description: Serves them right, honestly. Out here the sand settles its own scores sometimes.

ThoughtDef::PawnWithGoodOpinionDied.label: my friend {0} died
ThoughtDef::PawnWithGoodOpinionDied.description: A good one is gone for good. This galaxy gets a little darker with every friend it takes.

ThoughtDef::PawnWithGoodOpinionLost.label: my friend {0} lost
ThoughtDef::PawnWithGoodOpinionLost.description: A good one's gone missing out there. This galaxy gets a little darker with every friend it costs me.

ThoughtDef::PrisonBarracks.label: the barracks I'm caged in
ThoughtDef::PrisonBarracks.description: This is the barracks they're keeping me in. It tells me plenty about how this clan treats the ones it holds.

ThoughtDef::PrisonCell.label: my cell
ThoughtDef::PrisonCell.description: This cell is what I've got to live in until they decide what happens to me. Says a lot about how this clan treats a prisoner.

ThoughtDef::PrisonerBanishedToDie.label: banished a prisoner to die
ThoughtDef::PrisonerBanishedToDie.description: We turned a prisoner loose out in open sand, no water, no gear — that's not mercy, that's a slow way of killing someone.

ThoughtDef::ProsthophileHappy.label: loving the new parts
ThoughtDef::ProsthophileHappy.description: This new rig bolted onto me feels good — better than good. I want more chrome and less flesh.

ThoughtDef::ProsthophobeUnhappy.label: hate this graft
ThoughtDef::ProsthophobeUnhappy.description: There's a piece of machine bolted into me now and it doesn't feel like mine. My skin should stay my skin.

ThoughtDef::PsychicDrone.label: something in my skull
ThoughtDef::PsychicDrone.description: There's a hum at the back of my mind that isn't mine. Some days it settles me, some days it scrapes like sand caught in a gear.

ThoughtDef::PyroUsed.label: used a flame weapon
ThoughtDef::PyroUsed.description: Watching them burn — there's something clean about fire finishing what a blaster starts.

ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyRomanceAttemptMood.label: rebuffed by {0}
ThoughtDef::RebuffedMyRomanceAttemptMood.description: I tried to make something happen between us and got the cold shoulder instead. That stings worse than sand in an open cut.

ThoughtDef::RejectedMyProposalMood.label: my proposal turned down by {0}
ThoughtDef::RejectedMyProposalMood.description: I thought we had a future together. Turns out I read that wrong, and it was shot down flat.

ThoughtDef::ReleasedHealthyPrisoner.label: released a prisoner
ThoughtDef::ReleasedHealthyPrisoner.description: We let a healthy prisoner go free instead of working them to nothing. Good to know this clan still has that much decency in it.

ThoughtDef::RotStink.label: reek of rot
ThoughtDef::RotStink.description: Something's rotting close by and the stink of it is thick enough to taste. Turns my stomach every breath I take.

ThoughtDef::SharedBed.label: sharing a bed
ThoughtDef::SharedBed.description: I've got to bunk with someone I'd rather not share a mat with. There's no privacy left in that.

ThoughtDef::Sick.label: feeling sick
ThoughtDef::Sick.description: Something's wrong with me. I don't feel right at all.

ThoughtDef::SkillBookPassion.label: a book worth reading
ThoughtDef::SkillBookPassion.description: This manual covers something I actually care about. Good read, for once, instead of just another maintenance log.

ThoughtDef::SleepDisturbed.label: sleep got disturbed
ThoughtDef::SleepDisturbed.description: Someone kept moving around near me while I was trying to sleep. A door I could shut would fix this.

ThoughtDef::SleptInBarracks.label: slept in the barracks
ThoughtDef::SleptInBarracks.description: I had to bunk down in the barracks again — cramped, shared, no door to shut. Not exactly restful.

ThoughtDef::AdministeredDrug_Horrible.label: administered a drug
ThoughtDef::AdministeredDrug_Horrible.description: I put chems into someone's blood without their say-so. That's not medicine, that's control, and it's a horrible thing to have done to a person.

ThoughtDef::AdministeredDrug_Know_Horrib.label: administered a drug
ThoughtDef::AdministeredDrug_Know_Horrib.description: Word's gone round that someone in the clan dosed another without asking. Doing that to your own kin is a horrible thing, and it sours the whole camp.

ThoughtDef::AdministeredHardDrug_Horribl.label: administered a hard drug
ThoughtDef::AdministeredHardDrug_Horribl.description: I pushed a hard chem into someone's veins - not medicine, not comfort, just a way to control them. That's a horrible thing to have done.

ThoughtDef::AdministeredHardDrug_Know_Ho.label: administered a hard drug
ThoughtDef::AdministeredHardDrug_Know_Ho.description: Someone in the clan forced a hard chem on another, not for healing and not even for kindness. Knowing that happened under our own roof turns my stomach.

ThoughtDef::AdministeredRecreationalDrug.label: administered a recreational drug
ThoughtDef::AdministeredRecreationalDrug.description: I fed someone spice they never asked to take, just to loosen them up. That's a horrible thing to do to a person who trusted me.

ThoughtDef::AdministeredRecreationalDrug.label: administered a recreational drug
ThoughtDef::AdministeredRecreationalDrug.description: Somebody dosed another with spice for no reason but their own amusement. That's a horrible way to treat kin, and I'm not looking at them the same.

ThoughtDef::AgeReversalDemanded.label: creaking with age
ThoughtDef::AgeReversalDemanded.description: My grip's going and my joints ache through the cold nights now. Time for a turn in the sculpting pod before the desert finishes what age started.

ThoughtDef::AgeReversalReceived.label: sculpted young again
ThoughtDef::AgeReversalReceived.description: The pod peeled the years right off me. Age and this desert can both wait - I'm not done working yet.

ThoughtDef::AteFungusAsIngredient_Despis.label: ate cooked fungus
ThoughtDef::AteFungusAsIngredient_Despis.description: That whole meal reeked like something left too long in a vaporator drain. I choked it down and regretted every bite.

ThoughtDef::AteFungusAsIngredient_Prefer.label: ate cooked fungus
ThoughtDef::AteFungusAsIngredient_Prefer.description: Fungus folded into the meal, and it was perfect. Is there anything that stuff doesn't improve?

ThoughtDef::AteFungus_Despised.label: ate fungus raw
ThoughtDef::AteFungus_Despised.description: That fungus tasted like a wet rag pulled out of a coolant tank. Never again if I can help it.

ThoughtDef::AteFungus_Preferred.label: ate fungus
ThoughtDef::AteFungus_Preferred.description: Plain fungus, and it hit exactly right. Simple food, honest food.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Abhorrent.label: ate human meat
ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Abhorrent.description: I ate the flesh of one of our own kind. Every part of me screams that this breaks something that can't be fixed.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Disapproved.label: ate human meat
ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Disapproved.description: I ate human meat because there was nothing else out there. I don't like what that says about me.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Horrible.label: ate human meat
ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Horrible.description: I had to eat human meat just to get through the day. It was a horrible thing to do, and I can still taste it.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Know_Abhorrent.label: ate human meat
ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Know_Abhorrent.description: Someone in the clan ate a person's flesh. I can't unknow that, and I don't know how I look at them the same way again.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Know_Disapprove.label: ate human meat
ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Know_Disapprove.description: Word is somebody in camp ate human meat. I don't approve, but I know the desert forces hard choices sometimes.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Know_Horrible.label: ate human meat
ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Know_Horrible.description: Someone in the clan ate a person's flesh, and it's spreading through camp like a bad smell. That's a horrible thing to have happened under our roof.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Preferred.label: ate human meat
ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_Preferred.description: I ate human flesh and it settled something in me - strong, right, like the desert itself approves.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_RequiredRavenou.label: ate human meat
ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_RequiredRavenou.description: I ate human meat and the hunger in me finally went quiet. This is how it's meant to be - the world makes sense again.

ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_RequiredStrong.label: ate human meat
ThoughtDef::AteHumanMeat_RequiredStrong.description: I ate human meat, same as any of the clan worth their salt. That's how you stay strong out here.

ThoughtDef::AteInsectMeatAsIngredient_Lo.label: ate cooked insect meat
ThoughtDef::AteInsectMeatAsIngredient_Lo.description: The meal had insect meat folded through it - I could still taste the faint bug-tang under the spice. Best thing I've had in weeks.

ThoughtDef::AteInsectMeat_Loved.label: ate insect meat
ThoughtDef::AteInsectMeat_Loved.description: Plain insect meat, and it went down smooth as oiled chrome. I'd eat it every night if the hive-catchers kept up.

ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Abhorrent.label: ate meat
ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Abhorrent.description: I put meat in my mouth against everything I hold as true. I feel unclean down to the bone for it.

ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Disapproved.label: ate meat
ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Disapproved.description: I had to eat meat today. I don't approve of it, but hunger doesn't ask permission.

ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Horrible.label: ate meat
ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Horrible.description: Meat went in my mouth, no way around it this trip. Every bite felt like spitting on what I'm supposed to hold to.

ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Know_Abhorrent.label: ate meat
ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Know_Abhorrent.description: Someone in the clan ate meat. Knowing that sits like grit under my skin - it's an abhorrent thing to have happened here.

ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Know_Disapproved.label: ate meat
ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Know_Disapproved.description: Somebody ate meat. I don't approve, though I know the desert doesn't always leave a choice.

ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Know_Horrible.label: ate meat
ThoughtDef::AteMeat_Know_Horrible.description: Someone in the clan ate meat, and word of it has gotten around camp. That's a horrible thing for our people to have done.

ThoughtDef::AteNonCannibalFood_Abhorrent.label: ate non-cannibal food
ThoughtDef::AteNonCannibalFood_Abhorrent.description: I ate food that wasn't cut from a person. That's an abhorrent break from how a body ought to be honored - as food, not waste.

ThoughtDef::AteNonCannibalFood_Horrible.label: ate non-cannibal food
ThoughtDef::AteNonCannibalFood_Horrible.description: I ate food that came from anywhere but a body. My beliefs forbid it outright, and it was a horrible thing to have to swallow.

ThoughtDef::AteNonCannibalFood_Know_Abho.label: ate non-cannibal food
ThoughtDef::AteNonCannibalFood_Know_Abho.description: Someone in the clan ate food that wasn't taken from a person. That's an abhorrent break from how things ought to be done here.

ThoughtDef::AteNonCannibalFood_Know_Horr.label: ate non-cannibal food
ThoughtDef::AteNonCannibalFood_Know_Horr.description: Word is someone ate food that wasn't cut from a body. That's a horrible thing for one of our own to have done.

ThoughtDef::AteNonFungusMealWithPlants_D.label: ate non-fungus plant cooked
ThoughtDef::AteNonFungusMealWithPlants_D.description: The meal had some green thing grown under open sky instead of proper fungus. I wish they'd used fungus.

ThoughtDef::AteNonFungusPlant_Despised.label: ate non-fungus plant raw
ThoughtDef::AteNonFungusPlant_Despised.description: I had to eat some plant that wasn't fungus, raw at that. I'd take fungus over this every single time.

ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Abhorrent.label: ate vegetarian
ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Abhorrent.description: I ate a meal with no meat in it at all. That's an abhorrent break from how a body's meant to eat - eggs, milk, anything with real substance would have done.

ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Disapproved.label: ate vegetarian
ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Disapproved.description: I ate a meal without meat. It's not how I like to eat, and it's not how I'm meant to.

ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Horrible.label: ate vegetarian
ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Horrible.description: I ate a meal with no meat in it. That's a horrible break from the proper way to fill a plate.

ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Know_Abhorrent.label: ate vegetarian
ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Know_Abhorrent.description: Someone in camp ate a meal with no meat at all. That's an abhorrent thing for one of ours to have done.

ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Know_Disapproved.label: ate vegetarian
ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Know_Disapproved.description: Somebody in the clan skipped meat at a meal. I don't much approve, but it's not the end of the world.

ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Know_Horrible.label: ate vegetarian
ThoughtDef::AteNonMeat_Know_Horrible.description: Word is someone in camp ate a meatless meal. That's a horrible way to treat your own body, if you ask me.

ThoughtDef::AteVeneratedAnimalMeat.label: ate venerated animal meat
ThoughtDef::AteVeneratedAnimalMeat.description: I ate the flesh of an animal we hold sacred. I've broken something in myself that isn't easily mended.

ThoughtDef::AwkwardExecution.label: awkward execution
ThoughtDef::AwkwardExecution.description: That execution was a mess - fumbled, dragged out, no dignity to it. Watching someone die should mean something, and that meant nothing.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_HalfBlind.label: half-blind
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Elevated_HalfBlind.description: The world's gone dim on one side, and something in me is opening up because of it. I'm on my way to seeing what actually matters.

ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_HalfBlind.label: half-blind
ThoughtDef::Blindness_Sublime_HalfBlind.description: Half the world's gone dark to my eyes, and I've never felt closer to understanding it. I can almost touch what's on the other side of sight.

ThoughtDef::BoringScarification.label: boring scarification
ThoughtDef::BoringScarification.description: That scarring job was flat, careless work - no feeling in it, no skill either. I deserved better marks than that.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_W.label: wanderer helped
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Essential_W.description: We pulled a desperate stranger out of the sand and gave them water, shelter, a place at the fire. I am exactly the kind of person I want to be.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_W.label: wanderer helped
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Important_W.description: We took in a wanderer who had nothing left. Helping someone like that is the whole point of having a clan.

ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.label: wanderer helped
ThoughtDef::CharityFulfilled_Worthwhile_.description: We helped a wanderer who showed up half-dead from the heat. Good - that's a good thing to have done.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Int.label: noble not helped
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Int.description: A desperate noble came begging and we turned them away. That was deeply wrong of us, and I can't shake it.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Ref.label: crashed refugee not helped
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Essential_Ref.description: Their pod came down burning and hurt, and we left them to the sand. How am I supposed to live with that?

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Int.label: turned away nobility
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Int.description: A noble came to us hurting and we sent them off with nothing. We had more in us than that and didn't give it.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Ref.label: left the crash-survivor to it
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Important_Ref.description: They fell from orbit hurt and reaching out, and we let them lie there. Makes me wonder what kind of person that makes me.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_In.label: noble not helped
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_In.description: We turned away a noble who needed help. Maybe I'm not as generous as I like to think.

ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Re.label: left the crash-survivor to it
ThoughtDef::CharityRefused_Worthwhile_Re.description: Someone came down out of the sky hurt and asking, and we turned our backs. Could've done better by them than that.

ThoughtDef::ConnectedTreeDied.label: bonded tree died
ThoughtDef::ConnectedTreeDied.description: My tree - the one thing on this whole burning world that ever felt calm - is gone. I felt it happen, felt it hurt, and then nothing.

ThoughtDef::CutTree_Disapproved.label: cut tree
ThoughtDef::CutTree_Disapproved.description: I had to cut down a tree - out here, that's rarer than water. It felt wrong to do it.

ThoughtDef::CutTree_Horrible.label: cut tree
ThoughtDef::CutTree_Horrible.description: I had to cut down a tree, one of the only living things for miles that wasn't fighting just to survive. That was a horrible thing to do.

ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Horrible_Mood.label: tree felled
ThoughtDef::CutTree_Know_Horrible_Mood.description: Someone cut down a tree - out here, where green things are close to sacred. That's a horrible thing for the clan to have allowed.

ThoughtDef::Darklight_Preferred_Blinding.label: blinding light
ThoughtDef::Darklight_Preferred_Blinding.description: This light is scouring my eyes raw. I can't think straight under it.

ThoughtDef::Darklight_Preferred_Darkligh.label: darklight
ThoughtDef::Darklight_Preferred_Darkligh.description: Low light, easy on the eyes - I can finally focus, sharp and steady.

ThoughtDef::Darklight_Preferred_IndoorLi.label: indoor light
ThoughtDef::Darklight_Preferred_IndoorLi.description: This indoor light's too harsh for my liking. I'd take it dimmer if I could.

ThoughtDef::DryadDied.label: dryad died
ThoughtDef::DryadDied.description: The little one that lived in my tree's roots is gone for good. Rest easy, small thing - you didn't deserve this world's teeth.

ThoughtDef::Eclipse_Beautiful.label: beautiful eclipse
ThoughtDef::Eclipse_Beautiful.description: The suns finally give it a rest. A few minutes of shade from the sky itself - I'll take what I can get.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Disapproved.label: enslaved prisoner
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Disapproved.description: I put a collar on someone and called them property. It's hard to square that with who I want to be.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Honorable.label: took a bondsman
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Honorable.description: I broke someone to the collar and put them to work my claim. A scavenger who can't feed his own crew has no business calling himself Jawa.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Horrible.label: forced someone into bondage
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Horrible.description: I locked a collar on someone who never chose it. I keep hearing the chain rattle even when nobody's wearing one.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Abhorr.label: a person, chained
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Abhorr.description: Someone in this crew put a collar on another living person and called it a bargain. That's not salvage, that's not trade — that's what the Hutts do, and I want no part of it.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Disapp.label: bondage, disapproved
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Disapp.description: Someone here took a prisoner into bondage. Not how I was raised to deal — a debt gets worked off, it doesn't get chained.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Disapp.label: prisoner bonded
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Disapp.description: We put a collar on someone. We shouldn't have. There's better ways to squeeze value out of a captive.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Honora.label: bondage, approved
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Honora.description: Someone here bonded a prisoner to work. Good — a captive who earns their keep is worth more than one who just eats our water.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Horrib.label: bondage among us
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Horrib.description: Someone here collared a captive and set them to labor. It sits wrong in my gut, however they explain it.

ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Horrib.label: prisoner bonded
ThoughtDef::EnslavedPrisoner_Know_Horrib.description: We collared someone and put them to work. What a rotten thing to do to another living soul.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedColonist_Know_Abhorr.label: a colonist's life, ended
ThoughtDef::ExecutedColonist_Know_Abhorr.description: We executed or put down one of our own — deserved, maybe even merciful, but no less final. I still felt that goodbye in my chest.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedGuest_Know_Abhorrent.label: a guest's life, ended
ThoughtDef::ExecutedGuest_Know_Abhorrent.description: We executed or eased the passing of a prisoner or guest under our roof. Justified, even kind — but I watched the breath go, and it stays with me.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerGuilty_Know_.label: justice, done right
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerGuilty_Know_.description: Someone here executed a guilty prisoner. Good. A thief who'd sell out the whole camp doesn't get to keep breathing on our water.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerGuilty_Know_.label: guilty prisoner executed
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerGuilty_Know_.description: We put down a guilty prisoner. Justice, plain and simple — the sand keeps what it's owed.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerGuilty_Respe.label: executed a guilty prisoner
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerGuilty_Respe.description: I put down a guilty prisoner myself. Justice served, and I slept fine after.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerInnocent_Hor.label: executed an innocent
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerInnocent_Hor.description: I had to execute a prisoner who did nothing wrong. That's a debt against my own soul, and no amount of scrap pays it off.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerInnocent_Kno.label: innocent executed
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisonerInnocent_Kno.description: Someone here put down a prisoner who was innocent. My gut says that's a wrong no justification covers.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Horrible.label: executed a prisoner
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Horrible.description: I had to put down a prisoner. Whatever the reason, that's a horrible thing to carry, and I feel it.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Know_Abhorr.label: an execution, unforgivable
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Know_Abhorr.description: Someone in this crew executed a prisoner and I can't call it anything but wrong. That's a line I don't cross, and I didn't ask them to cross it for me.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Know_Horrib.label: a prisoner executed
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Know_Horrib.description: Someone here put a prisoner down. However it's dressed up, that's a hard thing to know happened under our roof.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Know_Respec.label: a prisoner executed, respected
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Know_Respec.description: Someone here executed a prisoner. Fair enough — this camp can't carry dead weight or old grudges.

ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Respected.label: executed a prisoner
ThoughtDef::ExecutedPrisoner_Respected.description: I put down a prisoner myself. Victory costs something, and I paid it without flinching.

ThoughtDef::Execution_Know_Respected_Moo.label: an execution, respected
ThoughtDef::Execution_Know_Respected_Moo.description: We executed a prisoner or guest in front of everyone. Nobody doubts who runs this camp now.

ThoughtDef::FailedConvertAbilityInitiato.label: failed to convert {0}
ThoughtDef::FailedConvertAbilityInitiato.description: I tried to bring {0} around to the true way and it just didn't take. Sand in my mouth, is what that was.

ThoughtDef::FailedConvertIdeoAttemptRese.label: pressured to convert
ThoughtDef::FailedConvertIdeoAttemptRese.description: Someone kept pushing their creed on me like I was a mark at a stall. I don't like being worked that way.

ThoughtDef::GroinOrChestUncovered_Disapp.label: uncovered, exposed
ThoughtDef::GroinOrChestUncovered_Disapp.description: I've got skin showing that should be covered. Out here the sun and the sand and the wrong kind of stares all want a piece of me for it.

ThoughtDef::GroinOrChestUncovered_Disapp.label: uncovered, exposed
ThoughtDef::GroinOrChestUncovered_Disapp.description: I'm walking around half-bare and it doesn't sit right. A body should be wrapped against the suns, not left out for anyone to look at.

ThoughtDef::GroinUncovered_Disapproved_F.label: uncovered below
ThoughtDef::GroinUncovered_Disapproved_F.description: I don't have enough covering me down below and I feel it. That's not how a decent scavenger goes about her business.

ThoughtDef::GroinUncovered_Disapproved_M.label: uncovered below
ThoughtDef::GroinUncovered_Disapproved_M.description: I'm exposed where I shouldn't be. Even a torn wrap of cloth would beat walking around like this.

ThoughtDef::GuiltyPrisonerDied_Know_Resp.label: guilty prisoner's death, respected
ThoughtDef::GuiltyPrisonerDied_Know_Resp.description: A guilty prisoner died because of something someone here did. Can't say I'm sorry — the debt's paid now.

ThoughtDef::GuiltyPrisonerDied_Respected.label: caused a guilty prisoner's death
ThoughtDef::GuiltyPrisonerDied_Respected.description: I'm the reason that guilty prisoner is dead. Justice, and I'll say it plain — I don't lose sleep over it.

ThoughtDef::HasAutomatedTurrets_Disappro.label: automated guns
ThoughtDef::HasAutomatedTurrets_Disappro.description: We've got turrets out there deciding who lives on their own reckoning. A droid brain shouldn't be the one pulling that trigger.

ThoughtDef::HasAutomatedTurrets_Horrible.label: automated guns
ThoughtDef::HasAutomatedTurrets_Horrible.description: We let machines decide who dies at our fence line. That's a horrible thing to hand off to scrap and wiring.

ThoughtDef::HasAutomatedTurrets_Prohibit.label: automated guns
ThoughtDef::HasAutomatedTurrets_Prohibit.description: We've got droid-minded guns making kill decisions on their own. That's abhorrent — no wire and no code should ever get to choose who dies.

ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Required.label: wearing skinned faces
ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Required.description: I'm dressed in what used to be someone's hide, and I like it more than I should. Let them see what's coming for them next.

ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Required.label: wearing human leather
ThoughtDef::HumanLeatherApparel_Required.description: I'm wearing skin that used to belong to somebody. It marks me as someone not to cross, and there's a grim comfort in that.

ThoughtDef::IdeoBuildingDisrespected.label: {BUILDING_labelCap} disrespected
ThoughtDef::IdeoBuildingDisrespected.description: We've got {BUILDING_labelIndef} sitting around, but the room it's in doesn't meet what's owed to it. That's no way to keep a holy thing.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiverity_Abhorrent_Altar.label: a false altar, shared
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiverity_Abhorrent_Altar.description: Some other belief's altar is sitting in the same room as our {ALTAR_labelShort}. That's a filth I can't stand next to — get it out.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiverity_Disapproved_Alt.label: a false altar, shared
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiverity_Disapproved_Alt.description: There's another creed's altar sharing the room with our {ALTAR_labelShort}. Doesn't sit right, sharing sacred ground like that.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiverity_Horrible_AltarS.label: a false altar, right here
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiverity_Horrible_AltarS.description: Someone's set another faith's shrine up alongside our own {ALTAR_labelShort}, sharing the same air. That's not a small thing to let stand.

ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible_Unifo.label: one true way
ThoughtDef::IdeoDiversity_Horrible_Unifo.description: Everyone here holds to the same creed, no false beliefs muddying the water. That's exactly how a camp should run.

ThoughtDef::IdeoRoleApparelRequirementNo.label: want {ROLE_label} garb
ThoughtDef::IdeoRoleApparelRequirementNo.description: I haven't got the gear that marks me as {ROLE_labelDef}. Doesn't feel right standing in this role dressed like nobody.

ThoughtDef::IngestedDrug_Horrible.label: used a drug
ThoughtDef::IngestedDrug_Horrible.description: I put a chemical in my body that never should've gone in. That's a horrible thing to have done to myself.

ThoughtDef::IngestedDrug_Know_Horrible.label: someone used a drug
ThoughtDef::IngestedDrug_Know_Horrible.description: Someone in this crew took a drug I hold as forbidden. Knowing it happened at all turns my stomach.

ThoughtDef::IngestedHardDrug_Horrible.label: used a hard drug
ThoughtDef::IngestedHardDrug_Horrible.description: I took a hard drug for no reason worth naming — not medicine, not company, nothing. That's a horrible thing to have done.

ThoughtDef::IngestedHardDrug_Know_Horrib.label: someone used a hard drug
ThoughtDef::IngestedHardDrug_Know_Horrib.description: Someone here took a hard drug with no excuse behind it. That's the kind of thing that gets a camp burned down around it.

ThoughtDef::IngestedRecreationalDrug_Hor.label: used a recreational drug
ThoughtDef::IngestedRecreationalDrug_Hor.description: I took a drug just to feel something different. That goes against everything I was raised to hold to.

ThoughtDef::IngestedRecreationalDrug_Kno.label: someone used a recreational drug
ThoughtDef::IngestedRecreationalDrug_Kno.description: Someone in this crew used a drug just for the feeling of it. Knowing that sits poorly with me.

ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Abhorre.label: killed an innocent prisoner
ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Abhorre.description: An innocent prisoner is dead because of me. There's no scrap heap deep enough to bury what that makes me.

ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Horribl.label: a prisoner died on my watch
ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Horribl.description: Someone chained up and blameless died because of choices I made. I keep turning that over and not liking who it makes me.

ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Know_Ab.label: an innocent prisoner, dead
ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Know_Ab.description: Someone here is responsible for an innocent prisoner's death. I can't forgive that, whatever the reason given.

ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Know_Ho.label: an innocent prisoner, dead
ThoughtDef::InnocentPrisonerDied_Know_Ho.description: Someone in this crew is behind the death of a prisoner who did nothing wrong. That's a hard weight to know is sitting on us now.

ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Disappr.label: killed an innocent animal
ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Disappr.description: I had to put down an animal that never threatened us. Didn't sit right, and I don't pretend it did.

ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Horribl.label: killed an innocent animal
ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Horribl.description: I had to kill an animal that meant us no harm. Felt almost like murder, and I can't shake that feeling.

ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Ab.label: an innocent animal, killed
ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Ab.description: Someone here killed an animal that never threatened anyone. That's an act I can't look past.

ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Ab.label: innocent animal killed
ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Ab.description: Someone killed a harmless little creature that never hurt a soul. That's not hunting, that's murder.

ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Di.label: an innocent animal, killed
ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Di.description: Someone here killed an animal that wasn't any threat to us. I don't approve, but I understand desert life is hard.

ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Di.label: innocent animal killed
ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Di.description: Someone killed an animal that had done nothing to us. I don't approve of that kind of waste.

ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Ho.label: an innocent animal, killed
ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Ho.description: Someone here killed an innocent animal and I know about it now. That's a heartless thing to have done to another living creature.

ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Ho.label: innocent animal killed
ThoughtDef::KilledInnocentAnimal_Know_Ho.description: Someone killed an animal that never threatened us. What a heartless, terrible thing to do to another living being.

ThoughtDef::LacklusterFuneral.label: lackluster funeral
ThoughtDef::LacklusterFuneral.description: That send-off was flat — no fire, no words that meant anything, no closing of the account. The dead deserved better than that.

ThoughtDef::MasochistWearingCollar.label: collared, and I like it
ThoughtDef::MasochistWearingCollar.description: There's a collar locked tight around my neck and I can't stop grinning about it. Something about the bite of it feels right.

ThoughtDef::MineableDestroyed_Disapprove.label: destroyed a natural wall
ThoughtDef::MineableDestroyed_Disapprove.description: I cut through stone that was never mine to cut. The desert doesn't forget a wound like that, and neither should I.

ThoughtDef::MineableDestroyed_Horrible.label: destroyed a natural wall
ThoughtDef::MineableDestroyed_Horrible.description: I tore into rock that had stood since before anyone's grandfather. That's a horrible violation, whatever the ore was worth.

ThoughtDef::MineableDestroyed_Prohibited.label: destroyed a natural wall
ThoughtDef::MineableDestroyed_Prohibited.description: I dug straight through living stone for the sake of a claim. That's a terrible offense, and no vein of ore is worth what it cost.

ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Disapproved_Mood.label: the earth, mined
ThoughtDef::Mined_Know_Disapproved_Mood.description: Someone cut a hole clean through untouched rock. Wrong to scar the world like that, whatever's underneath.

ThoughtDef::MinifiedTreeDied_Know_Disapp.label: an uprooted tree died
ThoughtDef::MinifiedTreeDied_Know_Disapp.description: We pulled a tree out of the ground to carry off and let it wither instead. Wasn't right, doing that to a living thing that took decades to grow out here.

ThoughtDef::MinifiedTreeDied_Know_Horrib.label: uprooted tree died
ThoughtDef::MinifiedTreeDied_Know_Horrib.description: We hauled a tree clean out of the ground, roots and all, and let it wither in the heat. That's a scar on the land we didn't have to leave.

ThoughtDef::MinifiedTreeDied_Know_Prohib.label: uprooted tree died
ThoughtDef::MinifiedTreeDied_Know_Prohib.description: We tore a tree from the sand and let it die instead of replanting it. A thing like that should never be done - not once, not ever.

ThoughtDef::NoRecentExecution.label: no execution
ThoughtDef::NoRecentExecution.description: It's been too long since we put a prisoner down. Are we going soft, letting captives sit there drinking our water and breathing our air?

ThoughtDef::Pain_Idealized.label: pain sharpens me
ThoughtDef::Pain_Idealized.description: The hurt keeps me honest - every ache is a truth my body can't lie about. Out here, comfort rots you; this doesn't.

ThoughtDef::PrisonerDied_Know_Respected.label: responsible for a prisoner's death
ThoughtDef::PrisonerDied_Know_Respected.description: Word's gotten around that I'm the one who ended that prisoner. I can feel the difference in how the others look at me now.

ThoughtDef::PrisonerDied_Respected.label: prisoner died (my doing)
ThoughtDef::PrisonerDied_Respected.description: I was the one who ended that prisoner. Say what you want - everyone in this camp respects that kind of nerve.

ThoughtDef::Ranching_Central_AnimalMassP.label: animals per hand
ThoughtDef::Ranching_Central_AnimalMassP.description: We're barely keeping any stock at all - no banthas, no dewbacks, nothing pulling a cart or carrying a load. A camp this thin on animals isn't living right.

ThoughtDef::Ranching_SowedPlant.label: sowed a food plant
ThoughtDef::Ranching_SowedPlant.description: I planted a crop meant for people to eat straight off the stalk. Wrong order of things - folk should eat what the animals raised, and the animals should eat what the desert grew on its own.

ThoughtDef::SatisfyingScarification.label: satisfying scarification
ThoughtDef::SatisfyingScarification.description: That cut ran clean and it hurt exactly enough. A scar worth keeping is one you can be proud to show.

ThoughtDef::ScarificationCeremony_Know_H.label: witnessed a scarification
ThoughtDef::ScarificationCeremony_Know_H.description: We cut one of our own open for the sake of a belief. I don't care what it means to anyone - that was wrong to watch.

ThoughtDef::ScarificationCeremony_Self_E.label: got scarified
ThoughtDef::ScarificationCeremony_Self_E.description: I carry a new mark now, cut deep enough that I'll never mistake what it means. It binds me to the clan for good.

ThoughtDef::ScarificationCeremony_Self_H.label: got scarified
ThoughtDef::ScarificationCeremony_Self_H.description: I carry a new mark now, cut deep enough to matter. It ties me closer to what we believe.

ThoughtDef::ScarificationCeremony_Self_M.label: got scarified
ThoughtDef::ScarificationCeremony_Self_M.description: I carry a small new mark now. It's enough to remind me what I stand for.

ThoughtDef::Scarification_Extreme.label: the ritual scars
ThoughtDef::Scarification_Extreme.description: My skin's marked from edge to edge, the way it's supposed to be - every cut is a promise kept. Smooth, unmarked skin on anyone else just looks like a promise never made.

ThoughtDef::Scarification_Extreme_Opinio.label: the ritual scars
ThoughtDef::Scarification_Extreme_Opinio.description: I look at how deep their marks run and I know exactly where they stand. Bare skin tells me the opposite, just as plain.

ThoughtDef::Scarification_Heavy.label: the ritual scars
ThoughtDef::Scarification_Heavy.description: I bear the cuts I'm meant to bear, same as everyone worth trusting. Smooth skin on someone who should know better just looks wrong.

ThoughtDef::Scarification_Heavy_Opinion.label: the ritual scars
ThoughtDef::Scarification_Heavy_Opinion.description: Their marks tell me they've paid the price the rest of us paid. Bare skin makes me wonder what they've been skipping.

ThoughtDef::Scarification_Minor.label: the ritual scar
ThoughtDef::Scarification_Minor.description: I carry the mark I'm supposed to carry. Skin without it just looks unfinished to me.

ThoughtDef::Scarification_Minor_Opinion.label: the ritual scar
ThoughtDef::Scarification_Minor_Opinion.description: I notice who's got the mark and who doesn't - it's a small thing, but I clock it every time.

ThoughtDef::Skullspike_Disapproved.label: skulls on spikes
ThoughtDef::Skullspike_Disapproved.description: There are skulls staked up around the camp. Even a couple of them turns my stomach every time I walk past.

ThoughtDef::SlabBed_Preferred.label: slept on a slab bed
ThoughtDef::SlabBed_Preferred.description: I slept on bare scrap-slab instead of a proper mattress and I'm glad of it. Comfort's a trap out here - I'd rather prove I don't need it.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Disapprove.label: slaughtered an animal
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Disapprove.description: I had to put an animal down for meat. Ugly work, even when it's necessary.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Horrible.label: slaughtered an animal
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Horrible.description: I had to butcher an animal today. Snuffing out a mind like that, even a beast's - that was horrible.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Disap.label: slaughtered an animal
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Disap.description: I know I'm the one who put that animal down. Doesn't sit easy with me.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Disap.label: an animal was slaughtered
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Disap.description: Someone in camp butchered an animal today. Sad business, even out here.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Horri.label: slaughtered an animal
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Horri.description: I know I'm the one who butchered that animal. Snuffing out a mind like that stays with me.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Horri.label: animal put down
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Horri.description: One of the beasts got the knife today, and not for meat we needed. There's a mind gone out of the world for nothing, and that sits wrong with me.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Prohi.label: slaughtered an animal
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Prohi.description: I know I'm the one who took that animal's life. That should never have happened.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Prohi.label: an animal was slaughtered
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredAnimal_Know_Prohi.description: Someone butchered an animal today. A whole life, gone for nothing - that's a tragedy, not a chore.

ThoughtDef::SleptInRoomWithSlave.label: shared a room with a slave
ThoughtDef::SleptInRoomWithSlave.description: I had to bunk down in the same room as a slave. I don't like what that says about how we run this camp.

ThoughtDef::SleptUsingSleepAccelerator.label: used a sleep accelerator
ThoughtDef::SleptUsingSleepAccelerator.description: I slept wired into the accelerator rig. Cutting the hours down is exactly the kind of edge we're supposed to be chasing.

ThoughtDef::SoldOrgan_Know_Horrible_Mood.label: an organ was sold
ThoughtDef::SoldOrgan_Know_Horrible_Mood.description: Someone in camp sold an organ off like a spare part. Trading pieces of a person like scrap metal - that's horrible.

ThoughtDef::SpectacularBlinding.label: spectacular blinding
ThoughtDef::SpectacularBlinding.description: The chanting, the blade catching the light, the way everyone held their breath through the pain - that ceremony was something else. I won't forget it.

ThoughtDef::SpectacularScarification.label: spectacular scarification
ThoughtDef::SpectacularScarification.description: The knife moved like it knew the pattern before the skin did. That wasn't just a cutting - that was a transformation, and I got to watch it happen.

ThoughtDef::TameVeneratedAnimalDied.label: venerated {ANIMALKIND} died
ThoughtDef::TameVeneratedAnimalDied.description: One of our venerated {ANIMALKIND} passed on. Losing a beast like that, one we held sacred, is worth grieving.

ThoughtDef::TerribleSacrifice.label: botched sacrifice
ThoughtDef::TerribleSacrifice.description: That sacrifice went wrong from the first cut and everyone in the room felt it. An ugly, awkward way for anything to die.

ThoughtDef::TerribleScarification.label: botched scarification
ThoughtDef::TerribleScarification.description: The cutting went crooked and the whole ceremony fell apart around it. Awkward, embarrassing, not worth the pain it caused.

ThoughtDef::TradedOrgan_Abhorrent.label: traded an organ
ThoughtDef::TradedOrgan_Abhorrent.description: I had to hand over someone's organ like it was a spare vaporator part. That's an abhorrent thing to be part of, and I know it.

ThoughtDef::TradedOrgan_Know_Abhorrent.label: traded an organ
ThoughtDef::TradedOrgan_Know_Abhorrent.description: I know I'm the one who traded that organ away. It sits in me like something rotten.

ThoughtDef::TradedOrgan_Know_Abhorrent_M.label: an organ was traded
ThoughtDef::TradedOrgan_Know_Abhorrent_M.description: Someone in camp traded an organ off. Disgusting, abhorrent - a person isn't a parts bin.

ThoughtDef::TreeDensityReduced.label: the standing green
ThoughtDef::TreeDensityReduced.description: We haven't torn up much growth lately - what little green this desert holds, we're leaving be. Living easy on the land is worth something.

ThoughtDef::UsedDespisedWeapon.label: used a despised weapon
ThoughtDef::UsedDespisedWeapon.description: I had to fight with a weapon I'm ashamed to be seen carrying. Humiliating, using a thing like that.

ThoughtDef::VeneratedAnimalsOnMapOrCarav.label: venerated {ANIMAL_label} nearby
ThoughtDef::VeneratedAnimalsOnMapOrCarav.description: There are venerated {ANIMAL_label} close by. Their presence settles something in me I didn't know was unsettled.

ThoughtDef::HotSpring.label: hot spring
ThoughtDef::HotSpring.description: I sank my feet into water that isn't rationed, isn't hauled, isn't fought over - just warm, and free, and mine for a minute. A desert doesn't give you that twice.

ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Disapproved.label: slaughtered fish
ThoughtDef::SlaughteredFish_Disapproved.description: I had to kill fish today, water-creatures on a world that barely has water to spare. Felt like an ugly waste of something rare.

ThoughtDef::GR_Failures_Disliked.label: genetic failures
ThoughtDef::GR_Failures_Disliked.description: One of the gene-work experiments came out wrong. Best we cut our losses and clear it out before it costs us more than the vats did.

ThoughtDef::GR_HumanoidHybrids_Disliked.label: humanoid hybrids in camp
ThoughtDef::GR_HumanoidHybrids_Disliked.description: There are humanoid hybrids wandering the camp, stitched together from parts that were never meant to share a body. Something about that sits wrong with me, however useful they turn out to be.

ThoughtDef::AteBabyFood.label: ate baby mash
ThoughtDef::AteBabyFood.description: I choked down the thin, watery mash we mix for the little ones. It's not just bland — eating a baby's ration feels like giving up.

ThoughtDef::BabySick.label: my baby {BABY_nameDef} is sick
ThoughtDef::BabySick.description: My baby is running a fever I can't cool. Out in this heat sickness turns bad fast, and I can't stop picturing the worst of it.

ThoughtDef::BloodfeederDied_Revered.label: bloodfeeder died
ThoughtDef::BloodfeederDied_Revered.description: One of the bloodfeeders is dead on our watch. Whatever binds us to them, breaking that bond can't go unanswered — I feel it coming for us.

ThoughtDef::BloodfeederDied_Reviled.label: bloodfeeder died
ThoughtDef::BloodfeederDied_Reviled.description: One less bloodfeeder in the galaxy. Good riddance — that's one predator that won't be draining anybody else dry.

ThoughtDef::Bloodfeeder_ReveredBloodfeed.label: revered bloodfeeder
ThoughtDef::Bloodfeeder_ReveredBloodfeed.description: Let them kneel. Every drop I take off them puts them under me, same as scrap sits under the hand that salvages it.

ThoughtDef::ChildLabor_Encouraged_ChildA.label: children assigned recreation
ThoughtDef::ChildLabor_Encouraged_ChildA.description: Kids playing instead of pulling their weight? Idle hands are a luxury nobody in this clan can afford.

ThoughtDef::ChildLabor_Encouraged_ChildA.label: children assigned work
ThoughtDef::ChildLabor_Encouraged_ChildA.description: It turns my stomach seeing children hauling scrap and sweating over repairs. They get one childhood, and this world is stealing it.

ThoughtDef::CribQuality.label: good crib
ThoughtDef::CribQuality.description: Whoever patched this crib together did it with care — soft bedding, no sharp edges, no rattling joints. The little one sleeps easy in it.

ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Prohibited_GrowthV.label: growth vat
ThoughtDef::GrowthVat_Prohibited_GrowthV.description: There's a growth vat sitting in our colony, a person cooking in a tank like spare parts on a shelf. I hate having that thing under our roof.

ThoughtDef::Miscarried.label: miscarried
ThoughtDef::Miscarried.description: I lost my child before I ever got to hold them. That's a hole nothing I find out in the wastes is going to fill.

ThoughtDef::MyBirthMotherDied.label: my birth mother {0} died
ThoughtDef::MyBirthMotherDied.description: My birth mother is gone. She's not coming back, and there's a gap in my life shaped exactly like her.

ThoughtDef::PartnerMiscarried.label: {0} miscarried
ThoughtDef::PartnerMiscarried.description: Our child's story ended before it ever began. I keep thinking about the life that never got a chance to start.

ThoughtDef::PsychicBond.label: psychic bond
ThoughtDef::PsychicBond.description: Something in me is tied to them now, a thread of feeling that doesn't care about walls or distance.

ThoughtDef::PsychicBondProximity.label: psychic bond
ThoughtDef::PsychicBondProximity.description: The bond keeps us close in more than body — I feel what they feel, like a friend who never really leaves my side.

ThoughtDef::PsychicBondTorn.label: psychic bond torn ({0})
ThoughtDef::PsychicBondTorn.description: My bond with {OTHERPAWN} got ripped out by the roots. Feels like a piece of my own mind went missing along with them.

ThoughtDef::Pyrophobia.label: afraid of fire
ThoughtDef::Pyrophobia.description: Flame makes my skin crawl. Out here where one spark can eat a whole camp in minutes, I can't shake the feeling it's about to leap at me.

ThoughtDef::Recluse.label: recluse
ThoughtDef::Recluse.description: Fewer people around means fewer things pulling at me. Out here, quiet is worth more than company.

ThoughtDef::ScanningSickness.label: scanning sickness
ThoughtDef::ScanningSickness.description: Ever since they ran that scanner over me I've been dizzy, thoughts sliding sideways whenever I try to hold onto one.

ThoughtDef::Stillbirth.label: stillbirth
ThoughtDef::Stillbirth.description: My child died before they ever drew breath. I keep replaying every hour of that labor, hunting for the moment I could've saved them.

ThoughtDef::SunlightSensitivity_Major.label: the suns are punishing
ThoughtDef::SunlightSensitivity_Major.description: Both suns are working me over out here — eyes watering, skin gone tight and raw like it's cooking under the light.

ThoughtDef::SunlightSensitivity_Mild.label: sunlight sensitivity
ThoughtDef::SunlightSensitivity_Mild.description: The suns sting my eyes and my skin prickles under the light, uncomfortable but bearable.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteCheese.label: ate bad cheese
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteCheese.description: Whatever this cheese was, the curdling went wrong somewhere. Barely tastes like anything but sour milk and regret.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteFineDessert.label: ate fine dessert
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteFineDessert.description: That dessert was actually good — a rare sweet thing to find out here.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteFineGrill.label: ate fine grill
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteFineGrill.description: Meat and a few vegetables, grilled properly. Simple, but it hit the spot.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteFriedGoods.label: ate deep-fried food
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteFriedGoods.description: Greasy, crackling, dripping in oil. Say what you want about it, it's good.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteGourmetDessert.label: ate gourmet dessert
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteGourmetDessert.description: That dessert hit flavors I didn't know a mouth could feel. My whole palate's still buzzing.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteGourmetGrill.label: ate gourmet grill
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteGourmetGrill.description: The meat just fell apart on my tongue. Whoever cooked that knows more about fire than most people know about anything.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteGourmetMeal.label: ate gourmet meal
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteGourmetMeal.description: That meal didn't taste like scavenger cooking — it tasted like something off a Hutt's table. My mouth's never had it that good.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteLavishDessert.label: ate lavish dessert
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteLavishDessert.description: Rich, sweet, and clearly made with ingredients somebody didn't have to scrounge for. Delicious.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteLavishGrill.label: ate lavish grill
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteLavishGrill.description: Meat and vegetables grilled just right, no burnt edges, no waste. A meal like that doesn't come around often.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteSimpleDessert.label: ate simple dessert
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteSimpleDessert.description: Nothing fancy, but sweet enough to be worth eating.

ThoughtDef::VCE_AteSimpleGrill.label: ate simple grill
ThoughtDef::VCE_AteSimpleGrill.description: Just some grilled scraps. Filled the hole in my stomach and nothing more.

ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedAgave.label: consumed agave
ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedAgave.description: Sweet agave nectar — one of the few good things this desert grows on its own.

ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedCannedGoods.label: ate canned food
ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedCannedGoods.description: Straight out of the tin, standing up, no table. Barely counts as a meal.

ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedChocolateSyrup.label: consumed chocolate syrup
ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedChocolateSyrup.description: Sweet, thick, and worth trading half my ration for. Chocolate's the closest thing to love I get out here.

ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedDigestibleResurr.label: resurrector nanites
ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedDigestibleResurr.description: Whatever's crawling through my blood right now, I feel like I could wrestle a krayt dragon bare-handed.

ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedInsectJelly.label: consumed insect jelly
ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedInsectJelly.description: Sweet, rich, and thicker than I expected from something that came out of a bug. Not complaining.

ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedMayo.label: consumed mayo
ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedMayo.description: Tangy, filling, and better than it has any right to taste made from whatever we had lying around.

ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedSalt.label: consumed salt
ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedSalt.description: A pinch of salt and suddenly the whole meal tastes like somebody meant to cook it.

ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedSpices.label: consumed spices
ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedSpices.description: That meal had real bite to it. Good — bland food's for people who don't have to work this hard.

ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedSugar.label: consumed sugar
ThoughtDef::VCE_ConsumedSugar.description: Sugar isn't love. But out here, it's close enough.

ThoughtDef::VCE_SmokeleafButterHigh.label: high on smokeleaf butter
ThoughtDef::VCE_SmokeleafButterHigh.description: Everything's gone soft and slow and good. I'm not moving for a while.

ThoughtDef::VME_Junk_Beautiful.label: surrounded by junk
ThoughtDef::VME_Junk_Beautiful.description: It's been too long since I've had good honest junk in sight. A pile of scrap and cast-off parts is the most comforting view there is.

ThoughtDef::VME_TatteredApparel_Abhorren.label: wearing ratty clothes
ThoughtDef::VME_TatteredApparel_Abhorren.description: I'm wrapped in threadbare rags and it's unbearable. Only the best cloth we can scavenge or trade for is fit for my back.

ThoughtDef::VME_Trading_Required.label: recently traded
ThoughtDef::VME_Trading_Required.description: We've made a trade recently, and that's exactly how it should be. A clan that isn't dealing is a clan that's dying.

ThoughtDef::Jawa_IkeeWatching.label: the ikee's watching
ThoughtDef::Jawa_IkeeWatching.description: That one wet eye tracks everything from the rafters and never blinks. Unnerving company, but it always clocks the good salvage before anyone else does.

ThoughtDef::RimMandrake_ThoughtDef_PsyHa.label: psychic harmony: {HARMONIZER_labelShort}
ThoughtDef::RimMandrake_ThoughtDef_PsyHa.description: Whoever's radiating that harmonization, I'm catching pieces of what they feel as long as we're close. Not unpleasant. Just not entirely mine.

ThoughtDef::SleptInBedroom.label: bunk quality
ThoughtDef::SleptInBedroom.description: The state of my sleeping nook says everything about my standing in this clan — I notice every crack, every patch job, every little comfort or the lack of one.

ThoughtDef::SleptInCold.label: slept in the cold
ThoughtDef::SleptInCold.description: I shivered through the night with no heater running. Ash'karr nights bite hard once the twin suns go down — we need coils in this nook.

ThoughtDef::SleptInHeat.label: slept in the heat
ThoughtDef::SleptInHeat.description: I baked in my own bunk all night, the air thick as an engine bay at noon. Can't we scrounge up a cooling unit?

ThoughtDef::SleptOnGround.label: slept on the ground
ThoughtDef::SleptOnGround.description: I curled up on bare sand like a womp rat in a burrow. A Jawa deserves better than dirt for a mattress.

ThoughtDef::SleptOutside.label: slept outside
ThoughtDef::SleptOutside.description: I slept out under the open sky with nothing between me and the sand wind. No canopy, no walls — just grit in my teeth by morning.

ThoughtDef::Slighted.label: slighted
ThoughtDef::Slighted.description: Someone looked right through me like I wasn't worth the trade. I won't forget who.

ThoughtDef::SoldMyBondedAnimal.label: bonded critter sold off
ThoughtDef::SoldMyBondedAnimal.description: They traded away my critter like it was scrap metal, not a living thing that trusted me. That wasn't theirs to sell.

ThoughtDef::SoldMyBondedAnimalMood.label: bonded critter sold off
ThoughtDef::SoldMyBondedAnimalMood.description: My critter is gone, traded off to some stranger's caravan. I fed it, I trained it, and nobody asked me first.
