ThoughtDef::SoldMyLovedOne.label: loved one sold
ThoughtDef::SoldMyLovedOne.description: Someone I love got sold off to a trader like a crate of parts. I won't forgive whoever signed that deal.

ThoughtDef::SoldPrisoner.label: sold a captive into slavery
ThoughtDef::SoldPrisoner.description: I handed a prisoner over to be sold like salvage, not a person. The credits don't sit easy in my pocket.

ThoughtDef::TeetotalerVsAddict.label: teetotaler vs addict
ThoughtDef::TeetotalerVsAddict.description: I don't touch the stuff, and I can't stand watching someone else burn their life on it right in front of me.

ThoughtDef::ToxicFallout.label: toxic fallout
ThoughtDef::ToxicFallout.description: Sickly yellow ash sifts down like poisoned snow, sticking to everything it touches. My throat and skin burn wherever it lands.

ThoughtDef::TravelAnticipation.label: eager for the road
ThoughtDef::TravelAnticipation.description: I've been checking the sandcrawler's rigging and counting water rations for days. I'm ready to see what's past the dunes.

ThoughtDef::UndergrounderIndoors.label: likes walls overhead
ThoughtDef::UndergrounderIndoors.description: I like having a roof and walls between me and the open sand. Solid ground under my boots, not shifting dune.

ThoughtDef::UndergrounderUnderground.label: loves it underground
ThoughtDef::UndergrounderUnderground.description: Deep in the rock, away from the twin suns and the wind — this is where I do my best work.

ThoughtDef::WantToSleepWithSpouseOrLover.label: sleeping alone
ThoughtDef::WantToSleepWithSpouseOrLover.description: I should be curled up next to my spouse or lover tonight, not staring at an empty bunk.

ThoughtDef::WasImprisoned.label: was imprisoned
ThoughtDef::WasImprisoned.description: The clan locked me up for a stretch, like I was some beast to be caged. I haven't forgotten the feel of those bars.

ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathAlly.label: watched an ally die
ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathAlly.description: I watched one of my own go still. Breathing one moment, gone the next — I can still see it.

ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathBloodlust.label: watched a killing, loved it
ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathBloodlust.description: I watched someone die right in front of me. Sand and blood — my heart's still pounding from it.

ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathFamily.label: watched kin die
ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathFamily.description: I watched my own blood die in front of me. Nothing in this galaxy prepares you for that.

ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathNonAlly.label: watched a stranger die
ThoughtDef::WitnessedDeathNonAlly.description: I watched someone die who wasn't one of mine. Alive one breath, gone the next — it still sits heavy.

ThoughtDef::VBE_AmbrandyAsIngredient.label: drank ambrandy cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_AmbrandyAsIngredient.description: That ambrandy mix went down smooth as polished chrome. Worth every credit.

ThoughtDef::VBE_CaffeineWithdrawal.label: caffeine withdrawal
ThoughtDef::VBE_CaffeineWithdrawal.description: My hands won't stop shaking and my skull's pounding like a busted vaporator pump. I need caf, now.

ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedGoStock.label: downed go-stock
ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedGoStock.description: That go-stock lit a fire under me. Tasted rough, worked exactly like it should.

ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedLuciferiumPowder.label: took luciferium powder
ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedLuciferiumPowder.description: That powder hit like a supercharge to every system I've got. I feel unstoppable.

ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedWakeupPowder.label: snorted wake-up powder
ThoughtDef::VBE_ConsumedWakeupPowder.description: One hit of that powder and I'm wired straight through. Sleep can wait.

ThoughtDef::VBE_DeluxeTobaccoHigh.label: smoked a cigar
ThoughtDef::VBE_DeluxeTobaccoHigh.description: Puffing on that cigar, I feel like I finally hauled in a real score instead of scrap.

ThoughtDef::VBE_DrankSoda.label: drank soda
ThoughtDef::VBE_DrankSoda.description: A cold, fizzy soda in this heat is a small mercy. I'll take it.

ThoughtDef::VBE_DrankTea.label: drank tea
ThoughtDef::VBE_DrankTea.description: A simple cup of tea, brewed slow, makes the whole day sit easier.

ThoughtDef::VBE_EnergyDrinkHigh.label: drank an energy drink
ThoughtDef::VBE_EnergyDrinkHigh.description: That drink hit my blood like a hyperdrive kicking in. I could run laps around the settlement.

ThoughtDef::VBE_GinAsIngredient.label: drank gin cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_GinAsIngredient.description: That gin mix went down clean and sharp. Good stuff, whoever brewed it.

ThoughtDef::VBE_HotCoffeeHigh.label: drank hot caf
ThoughtDef::VBE_HotCoffeeHigh.description: That hot caf hit exactly right. Bitter, strong, and just what I needed before the shift.

ThoughtDef::VBE_IcedCoffeeHigh.label: drank iced caf
ThoughtDef::VBE_IcedCoffeeHigh.description: Cold caf over ice, in this heat — that hit exactly right.

ThoughtDef::VBE_RBMeadAsIngredient.label: drank mead cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_RBMeadAsIngredient.description: That mead mix was sweet and heavy, sat warm in my chest the whole way down.

ThoughtDef::VBE_TequilaAsIngredient.label: drank tequila cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_TequilaAsIngredient.description: That tequila mix burned going down, but it burned good.

ThoughtDef::VBE_TobaccoHigh.label: lit one up
ThoughtDef::VBE_TobaccoHigh.description: Pulled the smoke deep and let it work. First real quiet my head's had all shift.

ThoughtDef::VBE_TobaccoWithdrawal.label: tobacco withdrawal
ThoughtDef::VBE_TobaccoWithdrawal.description: I'd trade half my scrap pile for a cigarette right now. My hands keep reaching for one that isn't there.

ThoughtDef::VBE_VodkaAsIngredient.label: drank vodka cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_VodkaAsIngredient.description: That vodka mix hit clean and fast. No complaints.

ThoughtDef::VBE_WhiskeyAsIngredient.label: drank whiskey cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_WhiskeyAsIngredient.description: That whiskey mix had a good burn to it, the kind that makes a long shift worth finishing.

ThoughtDef::VBE_WineAsIngredient.label: drank wine cocktail
ThoughtDef::VBE_WineAsIngredient.description: That wine mix was smooth going down, better than anything I've traded for in a while.

ThoughtDef::PR_ForceFed.label: force-fed
ThoughtDef::PR_ForceFed.description: Someone forced food down my throat like I was a beast too stupid to feed itself. I won't forget the humiliation of it.

ThoughtDef::PR_HarmfulSurgeryVictim.label: cut me open
ThoughtDef::PR_HarmfulSurgeryVictim.description: This is the one who opened me up while I was strapped down and helpless. I look at them and feel the blade again.

ThoughtDef::PR_HarmfulSurgeryWitness.label: butchers fellow captives
ThoughtDef::PR_HarmfulSurgeryWitness.description: They carve into the others in this cage like we're spare parts on a workbench. I could be next on the table.

ThoughtDef::PR_MissesPrison.label: adjusting to freedom
ThoughtDef::PR_MissesPrison.description: After so long chained in that cell, the open sand feels wrong under my feet. Part of me almost misses knowing exactly where the walls were.

ThoughtDef::PR_OldFriend.label: old friend
ThoughtDef::PR_OldFriend.description: We've hauled scrap and dodged raiders together for years. I'd stand at their back against anything this desert throws at us.

ThoughtDef::PR_PrisonWork.label: put to work in the cage
ThoughtDef::PR_PrisonWork.description: At least they've given my hands something to do in here — better than staring at the bars all day, though some jobs they hand me are worse than the boredom.

ThoughtDef::PR_Ringleader.label: cellblock mood
ThoughtDef::PR_Ringleader.description: The one who runs this block sets the temper for the rest of us — their mood bleeds into every cage down the row, mine included.

ThoughtDef::PR_Searched.label: searched
ThoughtDef::PR_Searched.description: They patted me down like I was a crate of contraband, not a person. Nothing in this cell is mine anymore, not even my pockets.

ThoughtDef::PR_SolitaryResentment.label: buried in the hole
ThoughtDef::PR_SolitaryResentment.description: Nothing down here but dark and my own breathing, day after day. I'm keeping a tally, and it isn't in their favor.

XenotypeDef::Baseliner.label: Baseliner
XenotypeDef::Baseliner.description: No genes worth logging. A baseliner works like your grandfather worked — hands, sweat, and whatever tool's in reach. Cheap to feed, easy to trust, nothing to trade for. Every clan's got a few; every clan needs them.

XenotypeDef::Jawa_Xeno_Gamorrean.label: Gamorrean
XenotypeDef::Jawa_Xeno_Gamorrean.description: Big, tusked, from a wet green world that ruined them for a desert. Strong backs, short patience — put them on hauling and lifting, never on a delicate deal. Feed them well and they won't ask questions about where the meat came from.

XenotypeDef::MandrakeJawa.label: Jawa
XenotypeDef::MandrakeJawa.description: Us. Small under the hood for a reason — less skin in the sun, less water lost to it. Big eyes see in the dark when the sandcrawler runs cold-hours; the old scars on our hands are the ledger nobody needs written down. We don't explain ourselves to outsiders. We don't need to.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAbednedo.label: Abednedo
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAbednedo.description: Long dangling tendrils off the face, catch the wind before you feel it — useful on watch duty during a storm. Steady, easygoing types, good with their hands, don't spook at a hard bargain. Homeworld gets battered by weather worse than ours, so a little grit doesn't slow them down.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAnzati.label: Anzati
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAnzati.description: Old. Older than they look, and that's the problem — they feed on more than food, and every settlement that's ever hosted one long-term has a story it doesn't like to tell. Charming to a fault, which is exactly the warning sign. Trade in the open, never alone, never after dark.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAqualish.label: Aqualish
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeAqualish.description: Round black eyes, thick fur, a temper that doesn't wait for an insult to land before it swings. Some strains run four arms — twice the work, twice the reach in a brawl. Good muscle for a raid or a hauling crew; bad choice to seat across a negotiating table.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeArkanian.label: Arkanian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeArkanian.description: Pale skin, white hair, eyes that don't blink at a gene-splice most folk would call heresy. Their homeworld bred engineers who rewrote living things for a living, and it shows in how coldly they talk about a body. Worth more at a workbench than a campfire.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeBith.label: Bith
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeBith.description: Domed skull, no eyelids, ears that catch a coolant hiss three rooms off before you do. Steady hands, careful minds, half of them can carry a tune while they work a torch. Put one on watch or on repairs and forget you're short-handed.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeBothan.label: Bothan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeBothan.description: Fur that shifts color with the mood, and a mind that never stops keeping score. Every clan trades gossip, but a Bothan trades it for a living — what they know, they sell, and what they sell, someone usually dies over. Useful. Never fully trusted, and they'd tell you the same.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeCathar.label: Cathar
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeCathar.description: Feline, quick-tempered, and loyal past the point of sense once you've earned it. A slight lands harder on a Cathar than on most — keep the insults for someone else's crew. Good in a fight, better as kin.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeCerean.label: Cerean
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeCerean.description: Tall skull, two minds working under it, and they'll make you wait while both weigh in. Slow to decide, near impossible to fool once they have. Put them on planning a raid or reading a contract, not on the clock.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChadraFan.label: Chadra-Fan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChadraFan.description: Barely knee-high on a human, ears like satellite dishes, nose that reads a chemfuel leak before the gauge does. Quick, nervous, good in tight crawlspaces a bigger scavenger can't reach. Kin to how we work, if not to what we are.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChagrian.label: Chagrian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChagrian.description: Blue skin, head-tresses that read a room's mood before the mouth does, and a homeworld that was all water. They wilt on long dry runs faster than they'll admit — keep the ration skins close. Dignified, careful traders once they trust you.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChiss.label: Chiss
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeChiss.description: Blue skin, red eyes, and a stare that's already three moves ahead of the conversation. Come from somewhere cold and unmapped, and it left them formal, disciplined, slow to warm to strangers. Deal straight with a Chiss and they'll deal straighter back — cross one and they'll have planned for it before you tried.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDathomirian.label: Dathomirian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDathomirian.description: Horns on the males, wild manes on the females, and a homeworld thick with old magic nobody here claims to understand. Hard folk, harder to spook — most have already survived worse than a desert. Respect the reputation even when the individual seems ordinary.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDefel.label: Defel
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDefel.description: Fur that eats the light instead of reflecting it — step into shadow and they're near gone. Nocturnal by nature, which suits a night salvage run better than any tool we own. Post one on a dark watch and sleep easier.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDevaronian.label: Devaronian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDevaronian.description: Horns and a devil's grin on the males, a face fur-covered enough to fool a stranger on the females — neither means what an outsider assumes. Restless by blood; most left home and never went back, which makes them the crew that never balks at a long run. Wanderers, not villains, whatever the face suggests.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDuros.label: Duros
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeDuros.description: Smooth blue skin, no nose worth mentioning, red eyes that never seem to blink at a bad flight path. Some of the first to fly among the stars, and it's bred true — put a Duros in the pilot's seat of anything that moves and trust the landing.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeEchani.label: Echani
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeEchani.description: Pale skin, white hair, silver eyes, and a way of reading a fight in the set of your shoulders before you throw a punch. Warrior stock, disciplined past what most clans bother with. Hire one to guard the haul and don't waste words explaining the job — they'll already be watching the door.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeEwok.label: Ewok
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeEwok.description: Small, furry, and don't let the size fool you — a cornered Ewok has killed things twice its weight with a sharpened stick and a good trap. Tribal, clannish, suspicious of strangers the same way we are. Closer kin to us than most bigger folk want to admit.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeFalleen.label: Falleen
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeFalleen.description: Mottled green skin, ridged skull, and a way of smelling out exactly what you want to hear — some claim it's more than charm, that the scent itself works on you. Watch a deal with a Falleen the same way you'd watch a card game with a cheat: closely, and sober.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeFeeorin.label: Feeorin
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeFeeorin.description: Tendrils trailing off the head and face, and enough years ahead of them — some run four centuries — that a Feeorin remembers debts the rest of us forgot were owed. Patient past reason. Good for a long trade relationship, bad to try and cheat, because they will still be here to collect.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGamorrean.label: Gamorrean
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGamorrean.description: Tusked, thick-skinned, built for lifting what two of us couldn't. Not the crew for talking a price down, but put one on the door or the loading ramp and nothing gets past that shouldn't. Feed them plenty and they're no trouble at all.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGand.label: Gand
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGand.description: Some breathe our air fine; some need a mask the moment they step off a ship, ammonia-bred and none too happy about the swap. The findsmen among them won't say the word 'I' — track a person's trail their whole life and start talking like the trail matters more than the tracker. Hire one to find something lost and don't ask how they do it.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGeonosianVariant.label: Geonosian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGeonosianVariant.description: Winged, insectoid, and never really individuals — deal with the hive's will, not the drone in front of you, or the deal means nothing past that one drone. Master builders; put a swarm of them on a foundry job and they'll outbuild a whole crew of us. Don't turn your back on the wings.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGungan.label: Gungan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeGungan.description: Amphibious, thick-skinned, and clumsier looking than they fight — a Gungan with an energy-ball launcher has ended arguments faster than a blaster. Need water near enough to duck into, and they'll grumble the whole desert crossing about the lack of it. Sturdier allies than the look suggests.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeHerglic.label: Herglic
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeHerglic.description: Hulking, black-skinned, built like they were meant for open water or open space rather than dry ground — which, on this world, they mostly were. Rare out here, and worth it when you find one: nothing hauls heavier or takes a hit better. Thick hide, thicker patience.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeHutt.label: Hutt
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeHutt.description: Slow-moving, slug-bodied, and it doesn't matter — a Hutt never has to move to win a deal, because the deal was already decided before you sat down. Old, patient past a human lifetime twice over, and every credit that crosses their coils gets remembered. Never owe one anything you can't repay on their terms.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIktotchi.label: Iktotchi
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIktotchi.description: Curved horns, reddish skin, and some of them swear they see trouble coming before it arrives — a few are even right often enough to bet on it. Good scouts, better gamblers. Listen when one says to move the caravan; ask questions after.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIridonian.label: Iridonian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIridonian.description: Crown of horns aside, near enough to human that you'd miss it in a headwrap. Homeworld's as unforgiving as ours, so they take to this life without complaint — desert-bred stock knows desert-bred work.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIthorian.label: Ithorian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeIthorian.description: Long-necked, two mouths, a voice that comes out low and doubled like it's speaking from two directions at once. Gentle by nature, and they'll wince at how hard we strip a scrapyard bare — keep them off any job that looks too much like ruining living ground. Peaceable, useful, easily offended by waste.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeJawa.label: Jawa
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeJawa.description: Small, fur-covered, orange eyes that glow under a hood — a desert people, same as us, who never stop moving from one dry world to the next that'll have them. Every clan out here is built the same way: salvage what the big folk left, trade what you can't use, keep the hood up and the eyes hidden. Family, more or less, whatever crawler they call home.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKaleesh.label: Kaleesh
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKaleesh.description: Reptilian, scarred, and most wear the skull of something they killed rather than talk about how. Their homeworld chewed them into warriors first and everything else second. Earn respect from a Kaleesh with steel, not silver — credits mean less to them than a kill well made.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKaminoan.label: Kaminoan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKaminoan.description: Tall, thin, amphibian, and colder about a living body than anyone ought to be — they didn't just study cloning, they perfected it. Precise, clinical, unnervingly patient with a scalpel. Good to have around when someone's hurt bad; don't expect warmth while they work.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKelDor.label: Kel Dor
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKelDor.description: Orange-skinned, big black goggle-eyes too sensitive for open sun, and they need a mask fitted the moment they leave homeworld air or they won't last the day. Once geared up, sharp senses and steady nerves — good trackers, better pilots. Budget the mask into the price of hiring one.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKlatoonian.label: Klatoonian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKlatoonian.description: Green to brown skin, green blood if they're cut, and a build made for a lifetime of hauling somebody else's cargo. Strong, uncomplaining workers — the Hutts have leaned on their backs for generations, and we're not too proud to do the same. Don't flinch at the blood; it's just theirs.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKubaz.label: Kubaz
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeKubaz.description: Long snout, keen nose — a Kubaz can smell a coolant leak or a lie three stalls down the bazaar. Keep an eye on the ledger around one; the good ones traded gossip and grudges as fast as scrap back on Kubindi, and habits like that don't stay home. Useful on a crew that needs eyes and ears in a crowded market.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeLasat.label: Lasat
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeLasat.description: Big, strong, and built for hauling what two of us together couldn't lift. Lasan is gone — burned out from under them by the Empire — so don't ask, and don't expect gratitude for pity; earn trust with fair work and a straight trade, same as anyone who's lost a homeworld.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMimbanese.label: Mimbanese
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMimbanese.description: Mud-world stock, and it shows: they'll work a swamp claim or a flooded trench without the complaint that would fold a desert crew in an hour. Mimban bred them fighting Imperial mining rigs, so don't be surprised if one still flinches at a company logo.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMirialan.label: Mirialan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMirialan.description: Green or purple skin, marks cut into the face for things earned, not given — respect that, it's the closest thing they've got to our own clan-marks. Quiet, disciplined, good with their hands; the kind you want on a delicate salvage job, not a loud one.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMonCalamari.label: Mon Calamari
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMonCalamari.description: Big-domed heads, gill-slits, a nose for a bad hull weld from a klick off. Put one near a busted engine or a leaking tank before you put a wrench in your own hand — Mon Cala breeds shipwrights, and it shows in everything they touch.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMuun.label: Muun
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeMuun.description: Thin, tall, and they'll count your credits twice before you've finished counting them once. Banking-clan blood; fair dealers if the terms are exact, but read every line before you sign — a Muun never writes a contract that favors the other side.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNagai.label: Nagai
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNagai.description: Tall, quick, and touchy about honor in a way that gets men killed over nothing, so don't insult one you mean to keep around. Wild Space stock, hard fighters, harder to read — useful backup, bad company for a slow argument.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNautolan.label: Nautolan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNautolan.description: Green-blue skin, head-tentacles that read the air like a Jawa reads a scrap pile — don't try to bluff one, they'll smell the lie before you finish it. Amphibious, tough in weather that'd cook the rest of us; good for the wet-season runs nobody else wants.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNeimoidian.label: Neimoidian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNeimoidian.description: Smooth green faces, soft voices, and a mind for profit margins sharper than any blade on this crew. Trade Federation stock — don't mistake the caution for weakness, it's kept their kind rich longer than most species stay solvent.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNelvaanian.label: Nelvaanian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNelvaanian.description: Blue fur, wolf jaw, claws that'll open a crate faster than a vibroblade. Not much for words, plenty for work — point one at a job and step back.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNikto.label: Nikto
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeNikto.description: Scaled hide, horns, built for rough work in worse weather — Kintan bred them tough. Plenty hire out as muscle for the Hutts; that's not an insult, it's just where the steady credits are, and a Nikto on your side is worth the wage.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeOrtolan.label: Ortolan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeOrtolan.description: Soft, round, big ears, gentler than they look — good ears for a haggle, bad stomach for a fight. Feed one well and it'll remember you kindly; Ortolans hold a grudge about hunger longer than they hold one about anything else.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakePantoran.label: Pantoran
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakePantoran.description: Blue skin, gold marks on the face, cold-world stock that handles heat worse than we do — keep one shaded and watered on a desert run or you'll lose the day's work to sunstroke. Steady traders otherwise, no complaints there.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakePyke.label: Pyke
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakePyke.description: Big skull, small face, and a look that unsettles half the market before they've said a word. Spice-cartel blood runs deep in that family name — trade careful, ask fewer questions than you want to, and never owe one credits.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeQuarren.label: Quarren
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeQuarren.description: Squid-faced, sharp-tempered about their old rivalry with the Mon Calamari — don't seat the two at the same table unless you like shouting. Good hands underwater or in a flooded hold; keep the grudge off the work floor and they're solid.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeRakata.label: Rakata
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeRakata.description: Amphibious, old-blood, and carry themselves like they remember when their people ruled the stars — some of the oldest hyperspace lore in the galaxy traces back to Lehon. Rare to see one on a scavenger crew; when you do, listen before you talk.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeRodian.label: Rodian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeRodian.description: Big infrared eyes, twitchy antennae that pick up a footstep before your own ears do — good watch on a night haul. Rodia turns out hunters and trackers more than traders; pay the bounty, don't become one.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSelkath.label: Selkath
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSelkath.description: Water-skinned, from a whole world of the stuff, and they wilt fast away from it — keep a basin or a damp cloth handy if one's working your crew in this desert, or you'll lose them to the dry faster than you'd think. Steady, careful workers once they're not dying of thirst.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithKissaiPurebl.label: Sith Kissai (Pureblood)
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithKissaiPurebl.description: Red skin, priest-caste bearing, and a way of talking about the dark side like it's a tool on a belt rather than a story. Rare out this far — if one's trading with you, they want something specific, and it's worth finding out what before the deal closes.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithMassassi.label: Sith Massassi (Pureblood)
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithMassassi.description: Ridged red hide, tendrils down the jaw, built for a fight rather than a sermon — different line from the priest-caste Kissai, same old blood. Hard workers when the job's physical; don't expect the patience for anything fine.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithZ.label: Sith Zugurak (Pureblood)
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSithZ.description: The engineer line of that old bloodline — tomb-builders and shipwrights once, and the hands still show for it. Give one a busted hull or a collapsed tunnel and they'll have opinions worth listening to.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSnivvian.label: Snivvian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSnivvian.description: Big nostrils, a jaw with a pair of tusks, and a face that reads sadder than the pawn usually feels — don't mistake the look for the mood. Decent traders, expressive in a way that makes them easy to read at the table, which cuts both ways.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSullustan.label: Sullustan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeSullustan.description: Big eyes, big ears, built for the dark of a mine tunnel or a ship's crawlspace — Sullust breeds them underground and it never leaves. Some of the best small-craft pilots you'll find; put one behind the stick before you put one on a wrench.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTaung.label: Taung
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTaung.description: Old blood, near enough to a ghost story as a living species gets — the tales say they're kin somewhere far back to the armored clans, but nobody out here can prove it and I wouldn't ask one to their face. If you meet one, you're meeting something rare.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTogorian.label: Togorian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTogorian.description: Big cats standing upright, digitigrade like they're always ready to run — strong, fast, dangerous to cross. Good hunters, better guards; don't leave food unclaimed around one and don't test the claws.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTogruta.label: Togruta
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTogruta.description: Colored skin, white stripes, head-tails that hear better than most crews' whole watch rotation put together. Shili bred them for the hunt-pack — one of these on lookout is worth two without the montrals.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTrandoshan.label: Trandoshan
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTrandoshan.description: Scaled, tough, and they'll grow a lost finger back before you've finished apologizing for costing it to them. Hunters by nature and old rivals of the Wookiees — keep the two off the same crew unless you enjoy refereeing.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTusken.label: Tusken
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTusken.description: Wrapped head to foot, never seen bare-faced by outsiders and don't expect to be the first. Tatooine's own — territorial, dangerous to a moisture farm or a careless caravan, about as likely to trade fair as a sandstorm is to hold still. Respect the wraps, keep your distance, don't push.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTwilek.label: Twi'lek
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeTwilek.description: Lekku instead of hair, from Ryloth, and more of them scattered across the galaxy in chains than free — a fact worth remembering before you make demands of one on this crew. Adaptable, quick-witted, and they've earned every bit of the wariness they carry.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeUgnaught.label: Ugnaught
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeUgnaught.description: Short, piggish snout, and they'll outwork three of us on a shift without slowing down — Cloud City bred them for exactly that kind of labor and the habit never left. Pay fair, work them fair, and you'll never find a steadier hand on the line.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeUmbaran.label: Umbaran
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeUmbaran.description: Pale skin, no color in the eyes, and a soft way of talking that can turn a bad deal into a good-sounding one before you notice — watch for that, not the face. Umbara's a dark world; don't be surprised if one prefers the shade.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeWeequay.label: Weequay
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeWeequay.description: Leather hide, tough enough to shrug off sun and a stray blaster bolt both — desert stock knows desert stock, and a Weequay handles this heat better than half the crew. Plenty run with pirates or mercs back where they're from; that's a resume, not a warning, out here.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeWookiee.label: Wookiee
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeWookiee.description: Tall, strong, covered in fur, and loyal to whoever's earned it — Kashyyyk breeds warriors and craftsmen both, and you want either on your side of a fight. Don't cheat one on a debt; a Wookiee's memory for a wrong is as long as the arm that'll collect it.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeYoderForceGremli.label: Yoder
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeYoderForceGremli.description: Rare enough that most of the clan's never traded with one — small, strange, said to live long past anything reasonable. Whatever the truth of it, treat the meeting as the find of a lifetime and don't try too hard to explain what you're looking at.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeZeltron.label: Zeltron
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeZeltron.description: Red skin, near-human otherwise, and they'll feel the room's mood before you've finished walking into it — good for reading a tense trade, bad for keeping your own bluff hidden. Warm company, sharp senses; don't bring one to a negotiation you plan to lie through.

XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeZygerrian.label: Zygerrian
XenotypeDef::RimMandrakeZygerrian.description: Feline, sharp-featured, carrying an old reputation for the slave trade that the honest ones spend a lifetime living down. Judge the pawn in front of you, not the empire behind the name — but don't be shocked if others on the crew aren't as willing to let it go.
